description: Every externally countable transitive ZFC-model \(M\) has a generic extension by the specified order on \(\omega\times\omega_2^M\) which is an externally countable transitive ZFC-model with the same cardinals and cofinalities and satisfies \(2^{\aleph_0}\ge\aleph_2\), hence \(\neg\mathrm{CH}\). Every generic for that order gives such an extension, with the named \(\omega_2^M\)-indexed family of distinct new binary reals. The full internal ZFC-model/cardinal theorem is unbound.
